human_choice.value: parent GitHub issue with native sub-issues and dependency links
human_choice.source: current human chat; explicit answer "Parent issue with sub-issues (Recommended)"
human_choice.subject: grouping convention only; full resolver, charter and action authority remain proposed

resolver.pagination: Follow every next Link; record each response and terminal page. Stop and mark incomplete when any bound is reached before exhaustion.
resolver.descendants: Traverse GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{number}/sub_issues recursively from the selected parent; follow all pagination links and include open and closed descendants. Record database/node IDs, parent edges and updated_at. Dedupe by repository plus database ID; reject cycles. Cross-repository descendants require separately approved repository scope.
resolver.fallback: Native hierarchy unavailable: use documented map task lists plus child Part of links only after explicit resolver-successor acceptance; never silently switch.
resolver.dependencies: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{number}/dependencies/blocked_by for each selected issue, fully paginate. Resolve transitive external blockers within the same finite bounds; verify acyclic graph. Closed external blockers need pinned satisfaction evidence; open/unreadable blockers prevent dependent admission.
resolver.dependency_fallback: Explicitly accepted successor may use documented Blocked by body lines; unsupported native API currently parks affected work.
exclusions: issues outside the selected parent hierarchy, including dependency-only external blockers (inspect blockers without adding them to executable scope)
explicit human-approved exclusions, provided they remove no required descendant or dependency
resolver.completeness: All seed, descendant and dependency pages exhausted; all memberships/edges/IDs and versions recorded; no unresolved scope or API failures; recheck drift before admission. Snapshot additions/removals require successor scope approval.
resolver.completion: Every frozen selected descendant independently passes required criteria, required merges/checks are verified and human trial disposition is recorded. With tracker-closing authority, close completed child tickets as completed and close the parent only after all required descendants and the trial pass. Parent state and counts alone do not prove acceptance.
resolver.trial_stop: Explicit checkpoint ticket IDs selected with the idea proposal; no selection yet.
resolver.root: Resolve the explicitly selected parent issue by repository and issue number. Reject pull_request objects. Record database/node IDs, state and updated_at. Include the parent in the frozen selection and recursively collect its native sub-issues in API order; never infer membership from a milestone, label, body mention or title.
resolver.execution: The selected parent is the grouping and aggregate acceptance ticket. Dispatch only explicitly approved implementation sub-issues; grouping tickets do not become implementation work merely by being included in the hierarchy snapshot.

inspection.scope: Successor convention for future work. No parent target selected or published; completed milestone run remains historical. Native sub-issue/dependency evidence reused from the completed interactive run and current official API documentation.

primary_sources.applicability: Exact parent-issue lookup; reject PR objects.
primary_sources.limitations: Documentation does not prove credentials or runtime resolver correctness.
Documentation supports native parent/child queries; no new target access was tested.
No network resolver ships with the control CLI; adapter must be supplied and validated.

supersession.reason: Human replaced milestone grouping with parent issue/sub-issue/dependency grouping for future work. Historical runs retain their frozen milestone selection.
